purpose: A personal intelligence and control platform that turns durable personal data, goals, context, policies, connected services, and device signals into transparent, user-controlled insights and actions.
primaryUsers: The owner of the Me+ system; architecture should remain extensible without assuming a multi-tenant product.

architecture.frontend: TypeScript monorepo with first-class web and mobile clients. Web handles dashboard, analysis, configuration and administration; mobile handles daily interaction, notifications, capture and device integrations.
architecture.backend: Shared TypeScript application/domain services plus narrowly scoped server-side functions; AI providers are reasoning dependencies, not the system of record.
architecture.database: Supabase Postgres as durable source of truth; migrations in repository; Storage only where needed
architecture.hosting: TBD after web/mobile framework bootstrap; keep deployment providers replaceable
architecture.authentication: Supabase Auth with least-privilege access and explicit authorization boundaries
architecture.authorization: User-owned data with row-level security; privileged operations stay server-side
architecture.isolation: Single-owner first, but schema and policies must preserve explicit user ownership so multi-user support remains possible
architecture.secretStorage: Deployment/repository environment secret stores; never Git or client bundles
architecture.sensitiveData: Personal data is private by default; minimize collection, redact logs, separate raw observations from derived insights, and require explicit authorization for external writes
architecture.boundaries: apps/web and apps/mobile are thin clients over shared packages. Shared domain logic and contracts live outside platform-specific UI. Supabase is durable memory/source of truth. Model providers reason over retrieved context but do not own canonical state. External connectors and device ingestion pass through typed adapters and auditable writes. Domain policies constrain reasoning and actions. Platform-native capabilities stay behind adapters so they cannot leak into shared domain code.

sourceControl.purpose: Branches, diffs, pull requests, CI, releases and durable engineering evidence

currentDocs.purpose: Verify current framework, SDK, AI provider and integration behavior before implementation

database.purpose: Durable memory, application data, authentication, row-level security, migrations and optional storage

hosting.purpose: Preview/staging and production deployment with environment isolation

browser.purpose: Rendered web UI, accessibility and end-to-end verification

codeRelationships.purpose: Understand architecture and change impact as the application grows

observability.purpose: Privacy-aware errors, runtime health and integration failure diagnostics across web, mobile and backend

analytics.purpose: Owner-visible product telemetry only when useful; avoid unnecessary personal-data collection

email.purpose: Notifications or reports only when a concrete Me+ workflow requires email

documents.purpose: Supporting documents and exports; canonical structured state remains in Supabase

issues.purpose: Track implementation work, decisions, defects and release readiness
